payload.title: Qwen board initialized
payload.body: This board tracks the QwenCreativeWriterAgent build: Kanban registration, real MLX generation, real MLX LoRA training, docs, and final verification. Board state is derived from append-only events.

payload.title: Create Qwen app-build Kanban board
payload.description: Add a QwenCreativeWriterAgent project to the reusable Overwatch Kanban app with source-truth hierarchy, actors, backlog cards, and event-log seed data.
acceptance: config/projects/qwen-creative-writer-agent.json exists
seed/qwen-creative-writer-agent.events.ndjson exists
UI can select the Qwen project
Smoke endpoint passes for the Qwen project

payload.title: Register Kanban requirement for all Hapa app builds
payload.description: Document that every new Hapa app build should get an Overwatch Kanban project before implementation work spreads across agents.
acceptance: Kanban README explains the all-build rule
Overwatch protocol doc explains the required project config/seed
Front-door AGENTS.md tells agents to use the board
Qwen AGENTS.md links its board and writeback rule

payload.title: Replace generation smoke with real MLX output path
payload.description: Verify and harden the QwenCreativeWriterAgent generation path so non-mock mode loads MLX-LM, streams real model text, sanitizes hidden-thinking output, and records metadata truthfully.
acceptance: HAPA_QWEN_CREATIVE_MOCK=0 uses scripts/mlx_worker.py
No generated payload includes the mock marker
Streaming and final text apply the same thinking-filter boundary
Real generation smoke evidence is appended

payload.title: Replace LoRA training mock path with real MLX-LM job proof
payload.description: Run and harden real mlx_lm LoRA training from the Qwen node, including dry-run command truth, non-deprecated command shape, telemetry parsing, adapter path output, and optional test pass.
acceptance: FineTuneManager builds python -m mlx_lm lora commands
Dry-run reports the exact command without running training
Real tiny training job succeeds with adapters.safetensors
Telemetry records train/valid/test metrics when available

payload.title: Validate Hapa training mine-to-train path
payload.description: Check that the Hapa Second Brain mining endpoint feeds the same real LoRA training manager and records dataset/job telemetry clearly.
acceptance: Mine endpoint creates a dataset manifest
Train endpoint can dry-run and real-run against a dataset_dir or dataset_id
Dataset path and job path are visible in API responses

payload.title: Confirm desktop/API parity for real MLX controls
payload.description: Make sure the Electron desktop and REST API expose model path, LoRA adapter path, real/mock worker mode, training controls, and job status without conflating test mock output with real MLX proof.
acceptance: Desktop reads worker mode and system status
Training panel can start dry-run and real jobs
Docs clearly separate mock smoke from live MLX proof

payload.title: Register Qwen board with agent docs and manifests
payload.description: Update Qwen agent docs and Hapa node metadata so future agents know where to write progress, blockers, verification, and handoffs.
acceptance: AGENTS.md names the Qwen Kanban project and event-log path
hapa-node.json and manifest.json advertise Kanban coordination metadata
API/feature docs mention live MLX verification commands

payload.title: Run final verification and append checkpoint
payload.description: Run board smoke, TypeScript checks, mock self-test, and explicit real MLX smoke where practical. Append a final checkpoint separating verified facts from remaining risk.
acceptance: Kanban smoke passes
npm run check passes
mock self-test passes
Real generation and LoRA results are recorded or blockers are explicit

payload.body: Overwatch online. MLX owns live inference/training proof, Blue owns source/API truth, Green owns desktop/operator parity, Docs owns agent registration, and Overwatch owns reconciliation. Append every claim and blocker here.

payload.title: Initial Qwen backlog checkpoint
payload.summary: The Qwen backlog is established around the user's requested sequence: make the board, register the pattern for all Hapa app builds, replace mock MLX proof with live generation, and verify real LoRA training.
